llmJudgeRequirements.description: Row container must set Reanimated `entering={...}` animation (for example `FadeInDown`) on `Animated.View`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Animated.View sets entering={FadeIn.duration(300).springify()} which is a valid Reanimated entering animation.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Row container must set Reanimated `exiting={...}` animation (for example `FadeOutUp`) on `Animated.View`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Animated.View sets exiting={FadeOut.duration(300).springify()} which is a valid Reanimated exiting animation.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: List rendering must use stable row identity via `keyExtractor`/`key` from persistent item IDs so entering/exiting animations bind to the correct row instances.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: FlatList uses keyExtractor={(item) => item.id} with persistent string IDs (e.g. 'row-1', 'row-2') assigned at item creation time.
